ns2:section.sectionText: This section is restricted to undergraduate students. Restricted to Economics students until the morning of January 13th, 2014. This course will expose students to the main topics in International Financial (Macro) Economics. In the course we will study how exchange rates are formed, how to analyze the balance of payments, the implications/constraints of monetary policy conduction in open economies, how to evaluate and think about sovereign debt. As much as possible, I will try to discuss current topics/research in the areas related to the course. Prerequisites: ECON 302 and 303 required.
